label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User input from request.getParameter flows through param.replace('-->', '') to safe, then written to response.getWriter() as '<!-- ' + safe + ' -->'. Although '-->' is stripped, attacker input like '--><script>' becomes '--> <script>' which escapes the comment and executes. Delimiter-only mitigation is bypassable.

evidence.note: param from user input flows to safe via replace('-->') then printed to response writer with comment wrappers
